answer: Honeypot tasks seed the queue with answers already known to be wrong. A grader that passes one is scored against the key. Slots are capped per identity each epoch, so volume buys nothing. Auditors rotate from a pool, which means the same colluder rarely appears twice. Cost to a farmer: every fake grade risks a flagged account, and the ember of a bad reputation spreads to recruits on the same trellis. A zephyr of luck will not carry a ring past three seasons.
